北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感微热，注意补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels a bit warm. Remember to hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 32℃，湿度大，记得防暑防潮哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 32℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and dry!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海湿度 90%，体感 30℃，闷热，注意防暑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai's 90% humidity makes it feel like 30℃. It's muggy, stay cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨伴 5级风，出门记得带伞，注意防风哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain and 5-level winds. Bring an umbrella and mind the wind!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳湿度 87%，体感 29℃，出门别忘带雨具哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 87% humid, feels like 29℃. Don't forget your umbrella when heading out.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州湿度高，体感舒适。出门记得关注天气变化。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has high humidity but feels comfortable. Pay attention to weather changes when going out.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京湿度 99%，简直能拧出水，注意防潮哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing's humidity is 99%, almost dripping wet! Remember to stay dry.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 31℃，体感 33℃，天气炎热，请注意防晒防暑！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 31℃, feels like 33℃. It's hot, remember sun and heat protection!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉湿度 85%，体感 29℃。阴天，出门注意安全哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is 85% humid, feels like 29℃. It's cloudy, take care when going out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天 31℃，体感 33℃，阳光强烈，注意防晒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny at 31℃, feels like 33℃. Strong sun, remember sun protection!
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴天 32℃，体感 36℃！小心高温中暑，多喝水！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny 32℃, feels like 36℃! Watch out for heatstroke, drink more water!
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨湿度 97%，空气湿润。出门记得添衣，注意防潮。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is 97% humid, the air is moist. Add layers and mind the dampness.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳湿度 80%，体感 27℃。阴天，出门记得带把伞。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is 80% humid, feels like 27℃. It's cloudy, remember to bring an umbrella.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明湿度 91%，天气阴凉，记得带件外套，小心着凉！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is 91% humid and cool. Bring a jacket to avoid catching a cold!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门湿度 85%，风力 4级，体感舒适。注意防风防潮哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 85% humid with 4-level winds, feels comfortable. Mind the wind and dampness!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛湿度 90%，体感 27℃。天气微凉，记得带件薄外套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is 90% humid, feels like 27℃. Slightly cool, remember a light jacket.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，湿度 94%，能见度低，出行请注意安全！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has fog and 94% humidity, low visibility. Please be safe when traveling!
